title: I'm leaving OpenAI to build Jurassic Park
excerpt: Gonna send you back to the stone age.
content_html:
I'm so grateful for my time at OpenAI, where I led alignment safety for the official ChatGPT basketball. I gained so much valuable experience building Altman's armageddon engines, and I'm taking it to the next level with my new startup: Jurassic Park.

At Jurassic Park, we're resurrecting the ultimate apex predators to defend humanity against misaligned AI.

Cyberdefense Capabilities

Further reading: OpenAI incident report, Anthropic incident report.

According to the fossil record, dinosaurs lived for 165 million years without a single recorded AI cyberattack. Many speculate that dinosaurs developed a natural immunity to artificial intelligence threats.

Datacenters evolved strong concrete exoskeletons to protect their vulnerable innards from predators. But think about it -- a dinosaur wins against pretty much everything (except maybe a literal meteor). In a recent poll, most scientists agreed that a dinosaur could totally destroy a datacenter if it really wanted to.

Anti-AI dinosaurs have already passed experimental trials in Japan.

In 1974, apes from Black Hole Planet 3 built a space-titanium imitation of Godzilla, which rampaged across Japan. But Mechagodzilla's disguise burned off and Godzilla (with assistance from the Okinawan guardian beast) turned him into a magnet and then tore his head off.

In 1975, the ape aliens built Mechagodzilla 2, who rampaged across Japan with Dr. Mafune's sea beast Titanosaurus. But Dr. Mafune's cyborg daughter discovered she was Mechagodzilla's wireless transmitter, and shot herself to sever the link. Godzilla seized this opportunity to decapitate Mechagodzilla 2 and blast its corpse with his signature heat ray.

Model Weights

Mass is estimated; only Chinese weights are public.

Sustainability

This chart assumes dinosaurs are ectotherms, not endotherms.

Dinosaurs are energy-efficient from cradle to plate! Dinosaur meat is a natural superfood -- rich in protein or omega-3 or something. We expect it to fetch a heavy premium at fancy steak restaurants when it first comes out.

We're committed to 100% circularity. Surplus dinosaur parts will be fully recycled into coal at our proprietary underground facilities.

Alignment

Everybody loves dinosaurs! Don't you want to cuddle these gentle giants?

Purchase our official life-sized Stegosaurus plushie from selected distributors.

Copyright

Contrary to popular belief, most dinosaurs pose no copyright infringement risks.

The Land Before Time (1988) was a decent film with superb animation, but the child-friendly sequels really tarnished the brand. We expect a reboot any year now.

Jim Henson's Dinosaurs aired on ABC from 1991 to 1994. Although targeted at a family audience, it somehow covered complex topics like sexual harassment, censorship, religion, steroid abuse, masturbation, and corporate crime. It got surprisingly good reviews; many appreciated its creepy-but-well-executed practical effects.

Economic Outlook

Top economists expect AI to take ~99% (±5%) of human jobs. We believe Jurassic Park is the ultimate jobs program.

AI cannot raise cattle, nor feed them to raptors with Spielberg's cinematic finesse. It cannot pick up mountains of feces ("poop") without a mechanized corporeal form. Human jobs are safe as long as we have dinosaurs.

Ancient humans harnessed the power of megafauna for megaprojects. According to The History Channel, ancient Egyptians used terrestrial sauropods to build the Great Pyramid of Giza.

Roadmap

  • Phase 1: Completed. Resort and theme park construction on Little Saint James Island.
  • Phase 2a: Ongoing. Research begins into growing organic dinosaurs in vivo.
  • Phase 2b: Coming soon. Park opens with really big horses and "killer" mechanized dinosaurs (built by Boston Dynamics). Our robosaurs will run the latest Grok 6.9 Mechahitler.
  • Phase 3: Probably. Jurassic Cafe adds literal dinosaur nuggets to the menu -- tastes like chicken.
  • Phase 4: Eventually. First organic dinosaurs enter the park.
  • Phase 5: Secure AI datacenter (with a big off-switch for safety) constructed inside the T-Rex exhibit.
  • Phase 6: The Loch Ness Monster fights Shamu clones in The Splash Coliseum™️ on Saturdays and Sundays.

AI scientists were so preoccupied with whether they could, they didn't stop to think if they should. Luckily, our dino scientists are doing what they must.

We're so excited to send you back to the stone age.

Disclosure: This post was partially funded by The Reptilian World Government.

content_html_zh:
我非常感谢我在 OpenAI 的经历，在那里我领导了官方 ChatGPT 篮球赛的对齐安全工作。 我在构建 Altman 的世界末日引擎方面获得了非常宝贵的经验，并且我正在通过我的新创业公司“侏罗纪公园”将其提升到一个新的水平。

在《侏罗纪公园》中，我们正在复活终极顶级掠食者，以保护人类免受人工智能的侵害。

网络防御能力

进一步阅读：OpenAI 事件报告、Anthropic 事件报告。

根据化石记录，恐龙生活了 1.65 亿年，没有发生过一次人工智能网络攻击记录。 许多人推测恐龙对人工智能威胁具有天然的免疫力。

数据中心进化出了坚固的混凝土外骨骼，以保护其脆弱的内脏免受掠食者的侵害。 但想一想——恐龙几乎能战胜一切（除了真正的流星）。 在最近的一项民意调查中，大多数科学家都认为，如果恐龙真的愿意的话，它可以完全摧毁数据中心。

抗AI恐龙已经在日本通过了实验试验。

1974年，来自黑洞星球3的猿类建造了一个哥斯拉的太空钛仿制品，并在日本横行。 但机械哥斯拉的伪装被烧毁，哥斯拉（在冲绳守护兽的帮助下）将他变成了一块磁铁，然后撕下了他的头。

1975年，类人猿外星人建造了机械哥斯拉2号，与马船博士的海兽泰坦龙一起横扫日本。 但马富恩博士的机器人女儿发现她是机甲哥斯拉的无线发射器，并开枪自杀以切断联系。 哥斯拉抓住这个机会砍下了机械哥斯拉 2 的头，并用他标志性的热射线炸毁了它的尸体。
